picks.title: Google plans to invest up to $40B in Anthropic
picks.why_it_matters: A $40B investment signals AI foundation model companies remain the most capital-intensive category in tech, reshaping competitive dynamics and raising the bar for what it takes to compete in enterprise AI.

picks.title: ComfyUI hits $500M valuation as creators seek more control over AI-generated media
picks.why_it_matters: The $30M raise at a $500M valuation for open-source AI tooling validates the creator-control layer as a fundable category, opening opportunities for startups building workflow tools on top of generative models.

picks.title: Two college kids raise a $5.1 million pre-seed to build an AI social network in iMessage
picks.why_it_matters: A $5M+ pre-seed for college founders building on iMessage shows investor appetite for AI-native social products and distribution strategies that leverage existing platform infrastructure.
